title.narrative: To contribute to achieving Vision 2030 through universal access to comprehensive HIV prevention, treatment and care - Kenya (01-Jul-2021-30-Jun-2024)

description.narrative: Kenya, HIV, Kenya Red Cross Society (KRCS)This program has the following goals: Contribute to attainment of universal health coverage through comprehensive HIV prevention, treatment and care for all people in kenya.. The objectives of this program are: Reduce new HIV infections by 75%. Reduce AIDs related mortality by 50%
